name: dsh-free-model
description: Free-model console for DSH: CodeBuddy + WorkBuddy account lanes (accounts, credits, daily auto check-in) and the local OpenCode lane (SSE streaming, config-driven catalog, image input), on two in-page tabs inside one settings section. Runs standalone; shares the account pool with dsh-our-free-model when present.
